title: Quasisimple groups with a proper subgroup having the same vector orbits in characteristic $2$
summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $G$ be a finite group, $H$ a proper subgroup of $G$ and $V$ a finite dimensional $GF(p)G$-module. The triple $(G,H,V)$ is immutable if and only if $G$ and $H$ have the same orbits on the vectors of $V$. We determine the immutable triples for $G$ a quasisimple group, $H$ a subgroup of $G$ and $V$ a $GF(2)G$-module.
